seoTitle: How to Connect a Squarespace Domain to Hostinger
metaDescription: Point a domain purchased through Squarespace to Hostinger hosting by updating DNS nameservers, then enable SSL for a secure site.
intro: If you bought your domain through Squarespace but want to host your site on Hostinger, you don't need to buy a new domain — you just need to update your nameservers. This guide covers accessing Squarespace's DNS settings, pointing to Hostinger, and verifying the connection.

steps.heading: Access Squarespace DNS settings
steps.body: Log in to Squarespace and open your domain's DNS settings, where nameservers are managed.

steps.heading: Find your Hostinger nameservers
steps.body: Log in to Hostinger and locate the nameserver addresses you'll need to point your domain to.

steps.heading: Update nameservers in Squarespace
steps.body: Replace the existing nameservers in your Squarespace domain settings with the Hostinger nameservers you found.

steps.heading: Verify the connection
steps.body: Check that your domain is successfully pointing to Hostinger — this can take some time as DNS changes propagate.

steps.heading: Enable SSL
steps.body: Once verified, enable SSL on Hostinger so your website loads securely over HTTPS.

faq.question: Will my site go down while I switch nameservers?
faq.answer: There can be a period of DNS propagation, but following the steps in order and verifying the connection helps minimize downtime.

faq.question: How long does DNS propagation take?
faq.answer: It varies, but it can take anywhere from a few minutes to 24-48 hours to fully propagate depending on your domain and provider.

faq.question: Do I need to buy a new domain to switch hosts?
faq.answer: No, you can keep your domain registered with Squarespace and simply point its nameservers to Hostinger.

faq.question: Do I need to set up SSL manually on Hostinger?
faq.answer: Yes, after your domain is connected, you'll need to enable SSL on Hostinger to ensure secure browsing.
